login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to book, manage your bookings and get personalized suggestions.
login.noAccount: Do not have an account yet?
login.mfaDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.enrollBody: This is your first sign-in with two-step verification. Add this key to your app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar) as a time-based account, then enter the code it shows.
login.enrollWarning: It is shown only this time. Do not share it or store it in a public place.
login.locked: Your account is locked for 15 minutes after several failed attempts. Try again later or contact an administrator.
login.oauthNotice: You continued with {provider}. Complete the sign-in to enter.

register.title: Create account
register.description: Your data is processed under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012. Choose which uses you authorize.
register.providerNote: Are you a tourism service provider? Create your account here and, after signing in, submit your application in “Become a provider”. The administration reviews it and, once approved, enables your provider portal.
register.passwordHint: At least 12 characters with an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, number and symbol.
register.consentTreatment: I authorize the processing of my personal data to create and manage my account (required).
register.consentCommercial: I want to receive commercial communications.
register.consentProfiling: I authorize AI profiling to receive personalized recommendations.
register.optional: Optional. You can change it at any time from your profile.
register.profilingHint: Optional and independent. If you do not authorize it, you will see general recommendations.
register.doneBody: We sent you a link to verify your account. Once you open it you can sign in.

errors.password: The password does not meet the security requirements
errors.treatment: You must authorize data processing to create the account

verify.title: Email verification
verify.ok: Your account was verified. You can now sign in.
verify.missingToken: The verification link is not valid.

recover.title: Recover password
recover.description: We will send you a link to create a new password.
recover.neutral: If the email is registered, you will receive a recovery link

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Your password was reset. We signed out your previous sessions for security.
